content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"no","applies_why":"The judge text dismisses C4 because the challenged curse limb was dropped, not because no single verse states the contrary, so the chain-against-chain requirement K-C governs is not engaged.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"'against a link' — one reading: K-C applies even if the target limb was dropped; the other: K-C applies only to a live link.","why":"The judge's reason is that the pressed limb is no longer live, not a verse-by-verse or stating-verse test forbidden by K-C."}
